title: Chop and Spin Lesson
subtitle: The Cruyff chop and the Antony spin, plus a cheeky lift, taught from one video and the 3D body reconstructed from it.
videoLabel: Original Cruyff chop and Antony spin video
sourceNote: one public skills clip (credit its creator before any real use), the body motion reconstructed from it, and measurements taken from that motion.

skills.name: Cruyff chop
skills.intro: Running at speed, he plants beside the ball and chops it back behind his standing leg, turning away from the defender in one movement.

notice.title: Run at him
notice.text: Ball rolling ahead, defender chasing on his inside.

notice.title: Chop
notice.text: The ball foot cuts the ball back behind the standing leg.

notice.title: Turn
notice.text: His body follows the ball round, away from the defender.

notice.title: Away
notice.text: He accelerates along the line with the defender wrong-footed.

skills.adds: Use the top view to see how sharply the path changes at the chop.
unsure: Which part of the foot chops the ball: the touch is quick and partly hidden.
Exact turn angles: he moves away from the camera, which blurs his hip line.

phases.name: Run at him
phases.cue: Pace on; make the defender chase.
phases.video: He drives forward with the ball a stride ahead.
phases.shows: His body travels about 1.9 m in half a second (relative to the camera).
phases.why: The camera pans with him, so distances are rough.

phases.name: Plant and chop
phases.cue: Plant beside the ball; chop it behind your standing leg.
phases.video: The ball foot swings across and chops the ball back behind the standing leg.
phases.shows: A touch by the ball foot at about 5.0 s, then his hips swing about 216° in under half a second.
phases.why: The touch is clear; the turn angle is rough because he faces away from the camera.

phases.name: Turn away
phases.cue: Follow the ball round; keep your body between it and the defender.
phases.video: His body comes round with the ball and the defender is left on the wrong side.
phases.shows: His standing foot is planted around 5.30 s as the body turns over it, about 19 cm lower than standing.
phases.why: Weight and plant are inferred from the 3D feet.

phases.name: Accelerate
phases.video: He takes it away along the line.
phases.shows: He runs straight away from the camera; the 3D follows his body but its depth is rough here.
phases.why: Running directly away from one camera is the weakest view for depth.

drills.title: Chop on the spot
drills.how: Ball beside your standing foot. Swing the ball foot across and chop the ball back behind your standing leg. Reset and repeat.
checks: The ball went behind my standing leg
I stayed balanced on the standing foot
My body turned with the ball

drills.title: Walk, plant, chop
drills.how: Walk with the ball, plant beside it and chop it back. Take two steps the other way.
checks: I planted beside the ball, not behind it
The chop changed my direction
I took two clean steps away

drills.title: At pace along a line
drills.how: Dribble along a line at jogging pace, then chop back and accelerate the other way.
checks: I didn’t slow right down before the chop
I accelerated after it
The ball stayed close

drills.title: Against a chasing defender
drills.how: A partner chases on your inside. As they draw level, chop back and go the other way.
checks: I chopped as they drew level
They went past me
I got away cleanly

challenges.title: Spot the chop
challenges.prompt: Tap the moment the ball foot chops the ball back.
challenges.label: Chop!
challenges.explain: The chop comes just as he plants beside the ball.

challenges.title: Where does the ball go?
challenges.prompt: Frozen at the chop. Where does he send the ball?
options: Behind his standing leg, the way he came
challenges.explain: The chop sends the ball back behind the standing leg, so his body turns with it and blocks the defender.

skills.name: Antony spin
skills.intro: He runs at the defender, then spins a full turn with the ball at his feet before taking it on. Mostly a show of control; watch how he keeps the ball under him the whole time.

notice.title: Start the spin
notice.text: He steps round the ball and starts to turn.

notice.title: Full turn
notice.text: Back to the camera, ball still under him.

notice.title: Take it on
notice.text: He comes out of the spin with the ball as the defender arrives.

skills.adds: The top view shows the full turn best. The defender blocks the camera near the end, so the last half-second of 3D is rough.
unsure: How the spin helps against a real defender: in the clip the defender arrives after it.
The ball’s position during the spin: it’s tracked in only a few frames of this shot.
The body after about 8.3 s: the defender covers him.

phases.name: Run at him
phases.cue: Ball close; draw the defender in.
phases.video: He dribbles at the defender with small touches.
phases.shows: He is upright and running at the defender, ball at his feet.
phases.why: Clear view, but the ball is tracked only in a few frames.

phases.name: Start the spin
phases.cue: Step round the ball and turn your back.
phases.video: He steps round the ball and begins to turn away from the defender.
phases.shows: His hips turn about 158° in 0.6 s.
phases.why: Turn measured from the hip line, relative to the camera.

phases.name: Full turn
phases.video: He completes the turn with the ball still at his feet.
phases.shows: From 6.9 to 8.1 s his hips turn about 368° in total: a full spin in just over a second, about 23 cm lower than standing.
phases.why: The camera barely moves here, so the turn is reliable; ball contact isn’t.

phases.name: Take it on
phases.cue: Come out of it with the ball and go.
phases.video: He comes out of the spin and the defender closes in.
phases.shows: The defender covers him from about 8.3 s, so the 3D after that is unreliable.

drills.title: Walk-through spin
drills.how: Ball between your feet. Step round it and turn a full circle, keeping the ball within a foot of you.
checks: The ball stayed under me
I finished facing where I started
I didn’t step on the ball by accident

drills.title: Both directions
drills.how: Spin left, then spin right. Use Mirror to watch the other direction.
checks: I could spin both ways
My balance held each time
I kept my head up as I came out

drills.title: From a jog
drills.how: Jog in, spin once and accelerate out in the same direction.
checks: I didn’t stop before the spin
I came out moving
The ball stayed close

drills.title: With a passive defender
drills.how: Spin as a partner approaches, keeping your back between them and the ball, then go past.
checks: My back shielded the ball
I came out on their weaker side
I accelerated away

challenges.title: How far has he turned?
challenges.prompt: Frozen mid-spin. How far does he turn in the whole move?
challenges.explain: The 3D measures about 368° from 6.9 to 8.1 s: he ends up facing the way he started.

challenges.title: Spot the start of the spin
challenges.prompt: Tap when he starts to turn his back.
challenges.label: Turn!
challenges.explain: His hips start to swing round as he steps past the ball.

skills.name: Lift over the defender
skills.intro: The video opens with a cheeky lift: he waits with his foot on the ball, scoops it over the defender as he arrives, then spins round him to collect it. The video doesn’t name it, so treat it as a bonus.

notice.title: Bait
notice.text: Foot on the ball, arms folded, looking away while the defender runs in.

notice.title: Roll it up
notice.text: Small touches roll the ball onto his foot.

notice.title: Over the top
notice.text: The ball goes up and over as the defender arrives.

notice.title: Spin and chase
notice.text: He turns round the defender to collect it behind him.

skills.adds: Turn the 3D to the side to see how low he gets under the ball before the lift.
unsure: The exact lift technique: his foot is hidden behind the ball at the key moment.
The ball’s height in the air: its depth is estimated from its size on screen.
The name of the move: the clip doesn’t give one.

phases.name: Bait
phases.cue: Foot on the ball; invite the tackle.
phases.video: He stands still with his sole on the ball and looks away, daring the defender to come.
phases.shows: His standing foot is planted from 0.43 s and his body stays upright.

phases.name: Roll it up
phases.cue: Small touches; get the ball onto your foot.
phases.video: A few quick touches move the ball onto the top of his foot.
phases.shows: 5 touches by the ball foot in just over a second, all in touching distance.
phases.why: Touches are counted when the foot comes within a few centimetres of the ball’s estimated position.

phases.name: Over the top
phases.cue: Lift it over just as they commit.
phases.video: The ball rises over the defender as he arrives.
phases.shows: His body drops about 24 cm as he lifts, and the 3D marks the ball as in the air from about 2.3 s.
phases.why: Ball height in the air is the least reliable reading.

phases.name: Spin and chase
phases.cue: Turn round the defender and collect it.
phases.video: He spins round the defender’s side and runs onto the ball.
phases.shows: He turns about 170° in under half a second, then runs away from the camera.
phases.why: Turn is measured from his hips relative to the camera, which pans a little here.

drills.title: Roll onto the foot
drills.how: Sole on the ball, roll it back onto the top of your other foot. Catch it there, then put it down.
checks: The ball came to rest on my foot
I kept my balance on the standing foot
I could do it without looking down for long

drills.title: Lift and catch
drills.how: From the foot, flick the ball up to head height and let it drop in front of you.
checks: The ball went straight up, not forward
It rose above head height
I controlled it on landing

drills.title: Over a cone, then chase
drills.how: Lift the ball over a tall cone, run round the cone and collect it before its second bounce.
checks: The ball cleared the cone
I ran round the cone’s side
I collected it before the second bounce

drills.title: Against a passive defender
drills.how: Let a partner jog in. Lift it over them as they close, spin round and collect.
checks: I waited until they committed
The lift went over, not into them
I spun round the side they weren’t facing

challenges.title: Why wait?
challenges.prompt: Frozen at the start. Why is he standing still with his foot on the ball?
options: To draw the defender in close before the lift
challenges.explain: The lift only works once the defender is close and committed; standing still invites them in.

challenges.title: Spot the lift
challenges.prompt: Tap the moment the ball leaves his foot and goes up.
challenges.label: Lift!
challenges.explain: The ball leaves the foot as the defender arrives.

challenges.title: Put it in order
challenges.prompt: Tap the moments in the order they happen.

limits: The camera pans with him in the chop, so distances there are rough; in the spin the defender hides him for the last half-second.
tests: Whether learners prefer one lesson per move, or the short combined clip.
